statement: Corporate income tax on a domestic corporation’s business-year income is computed on the Article 13 tax base at four bracket rates (Corporate Tax Act Article 55(1), as amended December 23, 2025 and in force January 1, 2026): 10 percent on a tax base up to KRW 200 million; KRW 20 million plus 20 percent of the excess up to KRW 20 billion; KRW 3.98 billion plus 22 percent of the excess up to KRW 300 billion; and KRW 65.58 billion plus 25 percent of the excess above KRW 300 billion.
caveat: The January 1, 2026 change raised each bracket rate by one point, and the table moves at tax-reform events; local income tax under the Local Tax Act applies on top of these national rates. Verify the live bracket table before relying.
